payload.reason: The evidence provides multiple claims regarding the interpretability merits of the approach, demonstrating how it improves model transparency and performance through crowdsourced keyword discovery and expectation estimation.

claims.text: The approach improves model training transparency by using crowdsourced keywords to provide human-understandable explanations for model performance.
By leveraging crowd workers to identify informative keywords, the approach enhances interpretability and allows insights into model learning for specific tasks.
The method outperforms traditional query expansion techniques by identifying keywords that are more relevant to the task, thus improving interpretability.
